projects.title: Protein Folding Dynamics Investigation
projects.description: Leading an end-to-end research initiative investigating protein folding dynamics, from hypothesis generation through preprint dissemination. This work integrates experimental workflows with large-scale quantitative analysis to understand fundamental biological processes.
highlights: First-author manuscript under review with preprint available
Developed scalable Python pipelines to analyze 80K+ peptide measurements
Navigated technical uncertainty in emerging methodologies like single-cell proteomics
Iteratively refined approach based on data-driven evaluation
